title: One-day cultural trip to Agra (from Delhi) — 27 Feb 2027

itinerary.title: One-day cultural trip to Agra (from Delhi) — 27 Feb 2027
itinerary.summary: Day trip from Delhi to Agra focused on heritage: Taj Mahal viewpoint, Agra Fort and Itmad‑ud‑Daula (Baby Taj). Pure-vegetarian meals, budget travel by train, no overnight stay.

outbound.description: Estimated early-morning reserved express/Intercity (Delhi → Agra) to reach Agra for morning sightseeing. Book a second-class reserved/CC/cheap Intercity to keep costs low.
outbound.departure: approx 06:00 from New Delhi station / Hazrat Nizamuddin (choose an early Intercity)
outbound.arrival: approx 09:00 — Agra Cantt / Agra Fort station

return.description: Estimated evening return train (Agra → Delhi). Book a reserved seat on an evening Intercity/express.
return.departure: approx 18:30 from Agra Cantt / Agra Fort station

transport.local: Auto-rickshaw and short cycle-rickshaw/foot transfers within Agra (station ↔ Taj complex ↔ Agra Fort ↔ Itmad-ud-Daula ↔ local market)

accommodation.name: No accommodation — day trip (return to Delhi same day)
accommodation.why: Travel is planned as a same-day return to Delhi, so no hotel night is required.

days.theme: Heritage: monuments, museum and local market
days.weather: Mostly dry, day max ~28°C — good for outdoor monument visits in the morning and late afternoon.

activities.name: Taj Mahal — main view & Taj complex (use View Point if shorter visit)
activities.description: Arrive early to see the Taj Mahal in the morning light. Walk the gardens, visit the main viewpoint and the Taj museum if time permits.

activities.name: Agra Fort
activities.description: Explore Agra Fort's Diwan-i-Khas, Jahangir's Palace and other Mughal-era structures; good for history and photos.

activities.name: Itmad‑ud‑Daula (Baby Taj) and nearby local market stroll
activities.description: Visit the smaller marble tomb (Itmad‑ud‑Daula). Afterward browse a nearby market for handicrafts and sweets (pure-veg snacks available).

meals.place: Station / nearby pure-veg stall or Bikanerwala (takeaway)
Bikanerwala or similar pure-veg restaurant near station before return

days.notes: Start early to avoid midday heat and crowds at the Taj. Carry original photo ID for Indian-entry tickets. Allocate time for tiffin / chai breaks between sites.

packingTips: Carry original photo ID for ticket checks (Aadhaar/driving licence/passport).
Comfortable walking shoes and a hat/sunglasses for midday sun.
Small bottle of water and hand sanitiser.
Light daypack for camera, tickets and purchases.
tips: Buy/browse Taj Mahal and Agra Fort tickets early (Indian citizen ticket counters are inexpensive).
Prefer pure-veg chains like Bikanerwala listed in OSM for assured vegetarian meals.
Negotiate auto-rickshaw fares beforehand or ask your train station prepaid counter for a taxi to reduce haggling.
Keep about 30–60 minutes cushion before train departures — Agra station can be busy.
